_comment: The Almanax calendar, flattened from the client dump by tools/extract_almanax.py.
dates     "dd/mm/*", "*" meaning any: the days this entry covers.
saint     the NPC of the day.
quest     the offering quest, found through the objective the entry names; its
bonuses   type and amount as the client gives them, criteria as [type, value].
The meaning of the types is not in the client data, only their names.
